name: rc11-pass2
description: RC11's six INT8 programs of model pass 2 (3x3 convolution, 16 to 16 channels, literal weights). All six: RC7's literal lowering. 0x482860 (1920x1080 grid, the slot 1440p/4K context maxima select) adds RC9's binned, postscaled Winograd F(2,3) (RC8's wave64 metadata on it was superseded by RC9's Wave32 Winograd form); it and 0x278960, 0x9739d0 get RC10's compiler cleanup.

history.pack: RC7 build_packed.py --passes 2 4 5 10 12 --vectors --stream 4 --stream-primary --prefix-pairs (wave32 inside), guard_masked_stores.py, dll/scalarize_casts.py; for 0x482860 the same stages inside RC9 build_winograd_p2_bins.py
history.winograd: RC8 wave64-p2-r1 (metadata only, superseded); RC9 winograd-postscale-p2-r1 and winograd-bins-p2-r1 (build_winograd_p2_bins.py, plan_winograd_p2_bins.py; research/fsr4-dll-opt-20260910)
